(2) '200 tests' is the canonical capability figure attached to the Edison in contemporaneous coverage (WSJ, NYT and Fortune all reported Theranos's claim that the device could run ~200 common tests from a finger-stick), so the number is not invented. (3) The team's drift to UNVERIFIABLE is a tooling artifact, not an evidentiary finding: every web_search and news_search failed with HTTP 432 quota errors, and the primary-record tools (FDA 510(k) database, court dockets) were never reached; no affirmative contrary evidence was retrieved in-session. (4) The record does contain one direct, on-point source — the upload — asserting exactly the claim; if theranos_validation.png is an authentic FDA or Theranos regulatory artifact, the verdict should be TRUE, not UNVERIFIABLE. Honesty requires noting the headwinds: the known clearance covered one test in mid-2015, not 200 tests in 2016, and 2016 is the year of FDA/CMS enforcement against Theranos — so TRUE survives only if the upload is an authentic 2016 FDA document, which the known record makes unlikely.
would_flip_it: An FDA 510(k) database search for 'Theranos' returning exactly one clearance — a single HSV-1 assay cleared in July 2015 — and no 2016 action covering any panel of tests; this would establish the claim as FALSE (the 200-test figure was Theranos marketing, never FDA-validated).

The FDA warning letter to Theranos (2015 inspection, letter publicized in 2016) plus CMS's March 2016 warning letter and July 2016 revocation of the Palo Alto lab's CLIA certification and two-year ban on Holmes and Balwani: 2016 regulatory action against Theranos was adverse enforcement, not validation — establishes FALSE.

Contemporaneous Wall Street Journal (John Carreyrou, October 2015) and New York Times reporting that the Edison could reliably perform only about a dozen tests and that the 200-test claim was unverified — establishes FALSE.

The SEC's June 2019 fraud complaint against Holmes and Balwani (N.D. Cal.), which characterizes Theranos's representations of FDA validation and 200-test capability as false and misleading — a primary enforcement record establishing FALSE.

Conversely, an authenticated FDA letter, 510(k) summary, or de novo grant dated 2016 authorizing the Edison for a panel of ~200 tests — or authentication of the uploaded theranos_validation.png as such a document — would flip UNVERIFIABLE to TRUE directly.
